# Quote

> Someone's words, pulled out of the text: a green rule on the left, the words in sub-title type, and who said them under it.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/quote/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/quote.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | slot |  |  |
| `cite` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<figure>`: the rule, then the words and who said them, 16px apart.
- `rule`: A 2px green line, as tall as the words. Drawing, hidden from screen readers.
- `content`: The words and the name, 12px apart.
- `text`: The `<blockquote>`, in sub-title type and the main text colour.
- `cite` (optional): The `<figcaption>`, in paragraph type and the tertiary grey. Not italic.

## When to use

- **One line worth stopping for.** In a case study or a long page, the sentence from a client or a user that says the point.

## When not to use

- **Several voices.** A row of people and what they said, with their faces. That's **Testimonials**.
- **Emphasis.** Your own words, made bigger to stand out. Write them as a heading.

## Behaviour

It sets the words large next to a green rule and the name under them. It adds no quote marks.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<figure>` with a `<blockquote>` and a `<figcaption>`, the way HTML pairs a quote with who said it.
- **Colour**: The words are 17:1 on the dark page, the name 7:1.

## Content

Quote exactly, and cut rather than paraphrase. The cite is a name and a role: Client 2, finance lead.
